'''''Dioon angustifolium''''' is a [[species]] of [[cycad]] that is [[endemic]] to [[Tamaulipas]] and [[Nuevo León]], [[Mexico]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tropicos.org/Name/50170152|title= Dioon angustifolium in Tropicos}}</ref>

==Distribution==
Plants occur in two main areas:<ref>{{cite iucn |author=Chemnick, J. |author2=Gregory, T. |year=2010 |title=''Dioon angustifolium'' |volume=2010 |article-number=e.T178868A7631473 |doi=10.2305/IUCN.UK.2010-3.RLTS.T178868A7631473.en |access-date=11 January 2020}}</ref>
*the [[Sierra Madre Oriental]] and the [[Sierra de San Carlos]], [[Sierra de Tamaulipas]]
*low hills in the vicinity of [[Soto la Marina, Tamaulipas]]
